findings.one_line: The proposed unrestricted latent-K classification (FPT or faithful linear-budget hardness) remains an open question; the delivered bounded-d and supplied-order algorithms are a strictly weaker kernel and must be positioned as such rather than as resolution of that frontier.

The claimed novelty of the live-label right-congruence DP lacks a theorem-level comparison with the closest path/interface or minimum-union dynamic programs; generic CSP and Set Cover lower-bound references alone do not establish what its state compression newly supplies.

The effect-fiber theorem is not positioned against the directly relevant bibliography entries GuoPerkovic2021 and StriederDrton2025; add a precise comparison of their target, supplied assumptions, and guarantees to the latent-K forest two-value result.
